verses.1: And the king and Haman went to drink with Esther, the queen.
verses.2: And the king said to Esther on the second day, during the feast of harvest: “What do you ask, Queen Esther? I will give you what you desire, and I will grant half of the kingdom to you.”
verses.3: And Queen Esther said, “If I have found favor in your eyes, king, and if you are willing to grant me what I ask, then my soul will be satisfied, and my people will also be blessed.”
verses.4: For I and my people have been sold as slaves to be destroyed and killed. We have been sold as servants and slaves. My children have also been sold, because there is no end to the harm that can be caused to the king.
verses.5: And Ahaziah said to the queen Esther, “Who is this man, and who is he who has the heart to do such things?”
verses.6: And Esther said, “This man is a wicked and evil person. He is hated by the king and the queen.”
verses.7: And the king got up in a hurry from his seat, from where he was sitting by the wine cup. He rushed into the courtyard of the palace. He stood there, pleading for his life from the queen. For she saw that all was evil about to happen to him because of the king.
verses.8: And the king came back from the palace to the dining room. The lion fell on the mat that Esther was sitting on. The king said, “Let’s go and take the queen with us into the room.” Those words came out of the king’s mouth, and the face of the lion turned pale.
verses.9: And one of the guards said to the king, “Look! There’s a tree that Manasseh built for Mordecai. It stands in Manasseh’s house, fifty cubits high.” Then the king said, “Hurl him down from that tree!”
verses.10: And he hung the man on the tree that had been prepared for Mordecai. And the blood of the king was also poured out on that tree.
